pr_title: Fix generated CSS scopes in layout views and update templates
pr_body:
Closes https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/31022 and part of https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/31030.

CSS isolation was working but a small bug in the Razor compiler resulted in the CSS scope being inserted incorrectly specifically for layout files.

Generated code before:

```csharp
WriteLiteral("\r\n<!DOCTYPE html>\r\n **TestCssScope**<html TestCssScope lang=\"en\">\r\n<head TestCssScope>\r\n    <meta TestCssScope charset=\"utf-8\" />\r\n    <meta TestCssScope name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0\" />\r\n    <title TestCssScope>");
```

Generated code after:

```csharp
 WriteLiteral("\r\n<!DOCTYPE html>\r\n<html TestCssScope lang=\"en\">\r\n<head TestCssScope>\r\n    <meta TestCssScope charset=\"utf-8\" />\r\n    <meta TestCssScope name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0\" />\r\n    <title TestCssScope>");
```

Also update the MVC template to use `.cshtml.css` for the layout by default.
